_comment: Permit additions for the shrooms site only. Text comes from official Forest Service pages fetched 2026-11-07. The skill's permits.md is untouched. Entries with verify=true are shown with 'verify before you go'.

entries.name: Mt. Hood NF
entries.rule: Up to 1 gal/day and 10 gal/year per person for personal use, no permit; cannot be sold, bartered or exchanged (commercial permit needed). Picking is prohibited in wilderness, research areas, developed recreation areas and riparian areas; no truffle harvest, no raking or digging.

entries.name: Willamette NF (2026-11 addendum)
entries.rule: All mushrooms must be cut in half. Picking is not permitted in wilderness, botanical, scenic or research natural areas, or inside fire closures.

entries.name: Siuslaw NF (2026-11 addendum)
entries.rule: Picking is prohibited in botanical areas, research natural areas, wilderness and scenic areas (for example parts of Cascade Head).

entries.name: Oregon State Forests (ODF)
entries.rule: The compiled permit file lists 1 gal or less per vehicle, no permit, for Oregon State Forests. This could not be re-confirmed on an official ODF page, so check with the ODF district before you pick.

entries.name: Private land
entries.rule: Picking on private land, including private timberland, needs the owner's permission. Many timber companies post or gate their land.

entries.name: BLM
entries.rule: No BLM rule for this district is in the compiled permit file. The Coos Bay BLM rule is under 1 gal for personal use with no permit; confirm with the local BLM field office before picking.

entries.name: OSU research forests
entries.rule: OSU research forests are managed for teaching and research. Access and any picking rules could not be confirmed online; contact OSU College Forests before picking.
